name: dsh-desktop
description: A cross-platform desktop shell for DeepSeek Harness.
author: DataElement

scripts.dev: npm run office:prepare && npm run ppt:build && electron-vite dev
scripts.build: npm run office:prepare && npm run ppt:build && electron-vite build
scripts.package:dev:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:dev:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:dev:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder-windows.mjs --win --x64 --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.cjs
scripts.package:mac:arm64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin arm64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: node scripts/verify-target.mjs darwin x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run build && node scripts/electron-builder-windows.mjs --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.pretest: npm run office:prepare && npm run ppt:build
scripts.pretest:watch: npm run office:prepare && npm run ppt:build
